plugins.name: context-weather
plugins.description: One band above the prompt: context size with its weather, your 5-hour and 7-day limits against the clock, the prompt cache countdown, session cost, a heavy-thread warning and the subagents running.

plugins.description: A recap of the conversation you just cleared, as a card to share: time worked, turns, tool calls, files and lines changed, test runs and cost.
